review_candidates.title: AI Solution Architect

In this role, you will be responsible for designing and delivering enterprise-scale AI and Generative AI solutions that help clients accelerate innovation and business transformation. As an AI Solution Architect, your main responsibilities will include: Design end-to-end architectures for AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions aligned with business objectives and enterprise standards.
